method: Conservative known-embedded-filename occurrence graph from current index.html; includes every name in Vite preload tables plus static/dynamic imports/CSS references, including potentially unused string entries. Supplemental local path-literal unresolved check. No JS or browser executed.
limitations: Static reachability overapproximation, not a runtime request trace.
Arbitrary future externally supplied plugin URLs are outside bundled UI asset closure.
Frozen binary embeds extra historical files; this is not byte-identical binary rebuild evidence.
